scripts.test: pnpm --filter @sprite-desktop/web test && pnpm --filter @sprite-desktop/web build && cargo test --workspace && tsx --test probes/rust-desktop/*.test.ts probes/view-runtime.test.ts && node --test probes/compare/metrics.test.mjs && pnpm test:installer
